name: FINTEL Vatuwaqa Communications Centre colocation/data centre
notes: FINTEL's official services page describes secure, resilient colocation/data-center environments at its Vatuwaqa Communications Centre in Suva; APNIC lists FINTEL's Vatuwaqa data centre among Fiji's operating data-centre infrastructure.

name: Fiji Government ITC Services Data Centre
notes: Government directory lists the Fiji Government Data Centre Building on Berkley Crescent, Suva; ITU says Fiji commissioned its first Government Data Centre in April 2011, and APNIC lists the Government ITC Centre as an operating facility.

name: Datec Fiji datacentre services / hosted infrastructure
notes: Datec's official site offers datacentre site services from Suva, including infrastructure management, testing/commissioning, micro and modular datacentre solutions; APNIC identifies Datec Fiji as part of Fiji's operating data-centre infrastructure, but public specifications are limited.

name: Telecom Fiji NextGen Data Centre
notes: Fiji Times reported Telecom Fiji's head of ICT saying construction of the proposed large facility would start in 2026 and take about 24 months; Telecom Fiji also issued an EOI for investors/partners in Fiji's first next-generation, internationally accredited, sustainable data center project. Exact site was not found publicly, so assigned to Central based on Telecom Fiji's Suva base and existing infrastructure references.

name: Google Natadola ICT facility / cable landing station with data transmission infrastructure
notes: Prime Minister's Office says PM Rabuka officiated the groundbreaking at Natadola in Nadroga Province and that the facility will hold a cable landing station plus data transmission servers/racks and power equipment. DCD clarifies it is a cable landing station/ICT facility, not a confirmed hyperscale data center; earlier public reporting cited about FJ$200 million investment.

name: Savusavu eCentre cable landing station / prefabricated data centre
notes: The Fijian Government commissioned Flexenclosure in 2018 to build an eCentre cable landing station in Savusavu, Vanua Levu; Flexenclosure describes eCentre as prefabricated data-centre technology. Later Telecom Fiji/Ciena reporting confirms the Savusavu-Labasa fibre backbone connects through the Savusavu Exchange/cable infrastructure, but public sources do not expose power or white-space specifications.
